info.name: UCYSS API
info.description: Every SentryPass endpoint with success and error cases. Run the whole collection top to bottom (Collection Runner or Newman): it creates its own users, exercises the API and deletes them again. Needs the admin account from the seeder. Wait a minute before re-running if you triggered the booking rate limit by hand.

item.name: 1. Setup

exec: pm.test("Returns a token and an admin user", function () { pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.user.role).to.eql('admin'); });
pm.test("Registration always creates a customer", function () { pm.expect(j.user.role).to.eql('customer'); });

item.name: 1.8 Customer 3 registers (used for the rate-limit demo)

item.description: Creates the users this run needs. Everything is deleted again in folder 11, so the collection can be re-run.

item.name: 2.2 Register with an email that is taken
2.5 Current user with a valid token

exec: pm.test("Clean JSON, no login redirect", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.eql('Unauthenticated.'); });

item.name: 2.8 The revoked token no longer works

exec: pm.test("Only organisers returned", function () { j.data.forEach(u => pm.expect(u.role).to.eql('organiser')); });

item.name: 3.5 Customer cannot read someone else's account
3.7 Customer updates their name and tries to promote themselves

exec: pm.test("Name changed, role ignored", function () { pm.expect(j.name).to.eql('Postman Customer One'); pm.expect(j.role).to.eql('customer'); });

item.name: 3.8 Password change needs the current password
3.9 Password change with the right current password
3.10 Admin cannot create a user with an unknown role

exec: pm.test("Owned by the organiser who created it", function () { pm.expect(j.organiser_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orgA_id')); });

item.name: 5.4 Public list filtered by category and status

exec: pm.test("Only published CTFs", function () { j.data.forEach(e => { pm.expect(e.category).to.eql('ctf'); pm.expect(e.status).to.eql('published'); }); });
pm.test("Exactly organiser A's event", function () { pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(1); });

item.name: 5.7 Event detail includes venue and tiers

exec: pm.test("Consistent error shape", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.eql('Resource not found.'); });

item.name: 6.1 Another organiser cannot add a tier
6.3 Owner adds the Solo tier (1 seat)
6.4 Owner adds the Pair tier (1 seat)
6.6 Owner renames a tier (it stays free)

exec: pm.test("Renamed, and still free", function () { pm.expect(j.name).to.eql("Solo seat"); pm.expect(Number(j.price)).to.eql(0); });

item.name: 6.8 Another organiser cannot update a tier
7. Bookings
7.1 Customer 1 books the last Solo seat (confirmed)

exec: pm.test("Confirmed with a signed ticket", function () { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('confirmed'); pm.expect(j.qr_token).to.have.length(64); });
pm.test("Waitlisted, first in the queue", function () { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('waitlisted'); pm.expect(j.waitlist_position).to.eql(1); });

item.name: 7.3 Booking the same tier twice is refused

exec: pm.test("Duplicate blocked", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.include('already have an active booking'); });

item.name: 7.6 Customer lists only their own bookings

exec: pm.test("Own bookings with event details", function () { pm.expect(j.data.length).to.be.at.least(1); j.data.forEach(b => { pm.expect(b.customer.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('c1_id')); pm.expect(b.ticket_type.event.title).to.be.a('string'); }); });

item.name: 7.9 The event's organiser can read it

exec: pm.test("One waitlisted booking on this event", function () { pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("PNG returned from the external API", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('image/png'); });

item.name: 7.13 A waitlisted booking has no QR code yet
7.14 Forged ticket is rejected at check-in

exec: pm.test("Tampering detected", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.eql('Invalid or tampered ticket.'); });

item.name: 7.17 Check-in with the scanning device's API key
7.18 A ticket cannot be used twice
7.22 The waitlisted customer was promoted automatically

exec: pm.test("Promoted with a fresh signed ticket", function () { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('confirmed'); pm.expect(j.qr_token).to.have.length(64); });

item.description: Covers the concurrency-safe seat logic, waitlist promotion, signed QR check-in and the device API key.

item.name: 8. Anti-scalping rate limit

exec: pm.test("Attempt 1 is processed (422 validation, still counts)", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); });
pm.test("Attempt 2 is processed (422 validation, still counts)", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); });
pm.test("Attempt 3 is processed (422 validation, still counts)", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); });
pm.test("Attempt 4 is processed (422 validation, still counts)", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); });
pm.test("Attempt 5 is processed (422 validation, still counts)", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); });

item.name: 8.6 Attempt 6 in the same minute is throttled

exec: pm.test("Anti-scalping limit with Retry-After", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.include('Too many requests'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Retry-After')).to.exist; });

item.description: POST /bookings allows 5 attempts per minute per user. Uses a customer that is only used here.

exec: pm.test("Fill, check-in and waitlist numbers", function () { pm.expect(j.capacity).to.eql(2); pm.expect(j.fill_rate).to.eql(100); pm.expect(j.attended).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.waitlisted).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.recent_checkins).to.have.length(1); });

item.name: 9.2 Another organiser cannot see the statistics

exec: pm.test("CSV with a header row", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('text/csv'); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.match(/^ID,Attendee,Email/); });
pm.test("Draft copy with all seats open", function () { pm.expect(j.title).to.match(/^Copy of /); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('draft'); pm.expect(j.ticket_types).to.have.length(2); });

item.name: 9.6 An event with active bookings cannot be deleted
10.8 A venue that still has events cannot be deleted

exec: pm.test("Guard message", function () { pm.expect(j.message).to.include('still has events'); });

item.name: 11.1 Cancelling the event cancels every active booking

exec: pm.test("Waitlisted and confirmed bookings cancelled", function () { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('cancelled'); pm.expect(j.cancelled_bookings).to.eql(2); });

item.name: 12. Paid tickets, seat holds and refunds
item.description: A paid ticket is held for a few minutes as "pending", then confirmed by paying. Payment is a sandbox: the outcome can be chosen.

item.name: 12.2 Organiser A creates a published event
12.4 Customer 4 books: the seat is held, not yet confirmed

exec: pm.test("Pending, with a hold that is counting down", function () { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("pending"); pm.expect(j.hold_expires_at).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(j.hold_seconds_left).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test("No ticket yet", function () { pm.expect(j.qr_token || null).to.eql(null); });

item.name: 12.5 A pending booking has no QR code
12.6 A declined payment returns 402 and keeps the hold
12.7 An unknown payment method is refused
12.8 Nobody else can pay for someone's booking
12.9 Payment approved: the booking is confirmed with a ticket

exec: pm.test("Confirmed with a signed ticket", function () { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("confirmed"); pm.expect(j.qr_token).to.have.length(64); });
pm.test("Says it is paid", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("already paid"); });

item.name: 12.11 Cancelling well before the event refunds the payment
12.12 The payment now shows as refunded
12.13 A cancelled booking no longer has a QR code
13. Numbered seats
item.description: On a seated event a guest chooses an exact seat. Only the organiser can see who holds it.

item.name: 13.3 Organiser A creates an event with numbered seats

body.raw:
{
  "venue_id": "{{venue_id}}",
  "title": "Postman Seats {{run_id}}",
  "description": "Created by the Postman collection.",
  "category": "workshop",
  "start_at": "2026-12-10T09:00:00Z",
  "end_at": "2026-12-10T12:00:00Z",
  "status": "published",
  "seated": true
}

item.name: 13.4 A tier of 4 seats in rows of 2
13.5 The public seat list names the seats and never who holds them

exec: pm.test("A1, A2, B1, B2, all free", function () { pm.expect(j.map(s => s.label)).to.eql(["A1", "A2", "B1", "B2"]); pm.expect(j.every(s => s.taken === false)).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 13.6 A seated event needs a seat to be chosen

exec: pm.test("Confirmed in seat A1", function () { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("confirmed"); pm.expect(j.seat.label).to.eql("A1"); });

item.name: 13.8 The same seat cannot be taken twice

exec: pm.test("Says the seat is gone", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("taken"); });

item.name: 13.9 The seat now shows as taken, without a name

exec: pm.test("No personal data in the public list", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include("@postman.test"); });

item.name: 13.10 The organiser sees the room and who sits where

exec: pm.test("A1 is booked by customer 5", function () { pm.expect(seats[0].state).to.eql("booked"); pm.expect(seats[0].guest.email).to.include("customer5"); });
pm.test("A2 is free", function () { pm.expect(seats[1].state).to.eql("free"); pm.expect(seats[1].guest).to.eql(null); });

item.name: 13.11 Another organiser cannot see the event's seat map
13.12 A customer cannot see the seat map
14. Online events and joining
item.description: An online event needs no venue. The meeting link is only given to a confirmed guest, once the meeting is open.

item.name: 14.1 Organiser A creates an online draft: no venue needed

exec: pm.test("Online, no seats, no link yet", function () { pm.expect(j.mode).to.eql("online"); pm.expect(j.seated).to.eql(false); pm.expect(j.meeting_url || null).to.eql(null); });

item.name: 14.2 It cannot be published without a meeting link
14.3 A link that is not a web address is refused
14.4 With a Google Meet link it publishes, and the platform is detected
14.6 The public sees the event, but never the link

exec: pm.test("Online, and no meeting_url field", function () { pm.expect(j.mode).to.eql("online"); pm.expect(j).to.not.have.property("meeting_url"); });
pm.test("The link is nowhere in the response", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include("abc-defg-hij"); });
pm.test("Link visible to the owner", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().meeting_url).to.eql("https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij"); });

item.name: 14.8 A customer does not see the link either

exec: pm.test("No link for a customer", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.not.have.property("meeting_url"); });

item.name: 14.9 Filter the event list to online events

exec: pm.test("Only online events, and ours is in the list", function () { pm.expect(rows.every(e => e.mode === "online")).to.eql(true); pm.expect(rows.map(e => String(e.id))).to.include(String(pm.collectionVariables.get("online_event_id"))); });

item.name: 14.10 Customer 5 books: confirmed, no seat, and a meeting that is not open yet

exec: pm.test("Confirmed with no seat", function () { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("confirmed"); pm.expect(j.seat).to.eql(null); });

pm.test("Meeting details without the link", function () { pm.expect(j.meeting.platform).to.eql("meet"); pm.expect(j.meeting.open).to.eql(false); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include("abc-defg-hij"); });

item.name: 14.11 Joining before the meeting opens is refused
14.12 Nobody can join with someone else's booking
14.13 Organiser A creates an online event that starts in 10 minutes

exec: pm.test("Zoom detected from a company subdomain", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().meeting_platform).to.eql("zoom"); });

item.name: 14.15 Customer 5 books: the meeting is open
14.16 Joining gives the link, and counts as attending

exec: pm.test("The link and the platform", function () { pm.expect(j.meeting_url).to.eql("https://uptm.zoom.us/j/123456789"); pm.expect(j.platform).to.eql("zoom"); });

item.name: 14.17 The booking is now marked attended

exec: pm.test("Attended, with a check-in time", function () { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("attended"); pm.expect(j.checked_in_at).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: 15. Drafts stay private
item.description: A draft is the organiser's work in progress. Nobody else can open it, and nobody can book it.

item.name: 15.8 It is not in the public list

exec: pm.test("Says the event is not open", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("not open"); });

item.name: 15.10 The organiser publishes it without waiting for an admin
15.11 Now the public can open it
16. Members-only tickets
item.description: A tier can be limited to UCYSS members. Only an admin can add someone to the member list.

item.name: 16.3 The public tier list says which tiers are for members
16.4 A customer who is not a member is refused

exec: pm.test("Says it is for members", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("members"); });

item.name: 16.5 A customer cannot make themselves a member
16.6 An admin adds the customer to the member list
16.7 The customer can now book the member tier
16.8 The admin can find people by name or email
17. Announcements to guests
item.description: An organiser can email everyone booked on their event (and the waitlist). Each person gets it once.

item.name: 17.1 Organiser A creates a published event
17.3 With nobody booked there is nobody to tell
17.6 Another organiser cannot write to this event's guests
17.8 The organiser sends it to everyone booked

exec: pm.test("Recorded with its audience", function () { pm.expect(j.subject).to.eql("Room change"); pm.expect(j.recipients).to.eql(1); });

item.name: 17.9 The history shows what was sent and who would hear now

exec: pm.test("One announcement, and an audience of one", function () { pm.expect(j.audience).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.data).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(j.data[0].subject).to.eql("Room change"); });

item.name: 17.10 The admin email log has an announcement row

exec: pm.test("At least one announcement email", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().total).to.be.above(0); });

item.name: 18.3 Forgot password gives a general answer

exec: pm.test("Does not say whether the account exists", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("If that email"); });

item.name: 18.4 An unknown email gets the very same answer
18.5 A wrong reset code is refused

exec: pm.test("Says the code is wrong", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("wrong or has expired"); });

item.name: 19. Cleanup
19.7 Admin deletes organiser A (and their event)

item.description: Removes everything created by this run.
